scope: Shared local agent system for Claude, Codex, and Antigravity in cogain-core

decisions.repositoryPolicy: Keep .agent and harness adapter files local-only under .git/info/exclude unless the owner later chooses a shared internal repo/package.
decisions.publishGate: No crawler, LLM, or MCP may write canonical SKILL.md content directly. External knowledge must move through evidence, proposal, eval, human approval, then publish.
decisions.socialSources: LinkedIn, Facebook, forums, and broad feeds are discovery leads only.
decisions.mcpPilot: Start with Microsoft Learn and GitHub read-only. Add other MCP servers only after a scoped read-only pilot.
decisions.evalCadence: Run static validation for local changes; run behavior evals nightly and whenever skill/model/MCP behavior changes.

sourceTiers.permission: Source of truth for project behavior
May create technical change proposals after Cogain applicability checks
May create review signals and proposals, not unilateral convention changes

examples: identified founder or senior engineer posts with verifiable examples
sourceTiers.permission: Discovery lead only; must be corroborated with T0 or T1
Discovery lead only; never direct skill patches

crawlPolicy.publishGate: evidence -> proposal -> eval -> human approval -> publish
hardStaleSignals: Referenced Cogain path or symbol no longer exists
Runtime or package major version no longer matches applies_to
Official deprecation or security advisory affects the skill
Relative link, script, or reference is broken
Behavior eval or contradiction eval fails
Configured model or MCP endpoint is deprecated
softStaleSignals: Minor or patch version drift touches the skill domain
New relevant source appears but is unmapped
Skill has no owner, usage signal, or eval for a full review cycle

evalCadence.nightly: Run routing and behavior cases across available harnesses.
evalCadence.skillOrModelChange: Run static validation plus behavior cases before publishing.
evalCadence.mcpChange: Run static validation, provenance checks, and a read-only pilot before enabling.
